meaning:
ταπεινοφροσύνη, -ης, ἡ
(ταπεινόφρων)
lowliness of mind, humility: Act.20:19, Eph.4:2, Php.2:3, Col.3:12, 1Pe.5:5; of a false humility, Col.2:18, 23 (rare outside of NT, but found in bad sense in FlJ, BJ, iv, 9, 2; also in Epictet., see Tr., Syn., § xlii).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: serving the Lord with all humility, with many tears, and with trials which happened to me by the plots of the Jews;
with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love,
doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;
